basic_info.description: Stunning Two-Bedroom Two-Bath Condominium with Private Walkout Terrace.  This beautifully upgraded residence features a fabulous walkout terrace that overlooks a serene rear garden. The open-concept living and dining areas feature engineered hardwood floors creating a warm and inviting space. The gourmet kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, custom-cabinetry and Caesar stone countertops. In-unit laundry includes a stacked washer and dryer. Both bedrooms feature hardwood floors, closet built-ins and access to outdoor space. Primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom featuring a shower over the tub. The second bedroom enjoys easy access to the second bathroom just across the hallway. This exceptional residence combines modern elegance with thoughtful upgrades, offering a comfortable and luxurious lifestyle.     One car deeded parking and two storage lockers. Building amenities include a beautiful marble entry, two elevators, landscaped rear garden, on-site maintenance person and evening security person on site every night.
